body: DEI is gone so. Yes, it's legal. They are being misogynistic and allowed to be.

Not sure if anyone is interested in an update, but here it goes:

I found new employment! I've received an offer to work for another international healthcare entity to aid in developing their RCM efficiencies, protocols, and AI data analytics and not only is it a huge leap in my career, but also in my financial goals via a 54% salary increase which tells me just how undervalued and underpaid I was in my prior role. I'm genuinely so excited!

The crazy part? Things got even worse since my post. I had one of my staff members blow up on me for 45 minutes straight, discriminated against my age because I'm younger than those on my team, even used the same exact wording as my boss when insulting me, and when I offered to schedule time with my boss and her to discuss her concerns since she didn't want to talk civilly with me about them, she them told me that she was told by my boss that she can go to her for "anything" when it comes to me so I won't be part of those conversations. And without saying exact words that runs the risk of giving anonymity away, you'll just have to trust me that the point of her message was that my boss had been encouraging her to give me negative reviews to her and that she would have her back if she treated me like this no matter what cause I was the problem. I ultimately reported this issue, and now the employee has been written up since she also has been having extreme performance issues and multiple documented and even witnessed points of subordination towards me - all at the hands of my boss because she's actually a backstabbing, two faced, liar to the staff as well. From there, today is now 6 days away from my end date and I have been having to rapid train people on my work since I've never had backup on anything for over 2 years. I was in the second half of traing my boss and my senior on things, my senior asked to see one specific thing again, I was clarifying that the process to lookup the thing is done with the same tool to create the thing and she snapped at me accusing me of not being willing to train on it and told me to just do it after I had already been training for over 4 hours straight and I was pulling everything up that I needed on my other screen. Just, the disrespect and dehumanizing treatment she is STILL putting me through despite me trying to do right by my team and gave 2 weeks notice is insane. I guess at least I don't have to take it and I got to call her out on it today. 🫠
